nom: Clinique Clinique For Men Face Wash

avis.texte: My husband used to wash his face with hand soap when he washed his hands, and it was causing his face to dry out so bad! He agreed to try this product instead of hand soap, and liked it so well he now asks me to buy it again when he's running low! It has a great lather, doesn't dry his face out, not overpowering, and I don't think it has a smell to it on his face. This is literally the only product I can get him to wash his face with.

I bought this for my husband three years ago and since then I've repurchased it ~6 times. I buy myself feminine marketed face wash, but I always end up using his and returning mine because this face wash is the best one I've ever used.

avis.titre: Oh heck yeah, brother (Hulk Hogan Voice)
avis.texte: Too many Men's shower products are the old, harsh 8in1: hair, body, face, carpet, car, dishes and beard or whatever. Just thank god for Clinique and the fact that they recognize that men deserve a variety of quality, effective skincare and hygiene products. Death to the men's 8in1 products

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I bought this for my fiancé last year for Christmas and he's been using it every since. It keeps his face clean, clear and fresh the moisturizer pairs extremely well with it. My fiancé loved that he has a skin care regimen now.

avis.titre: I will buy this product again.
avis.texte: My husband has been using this product for about 2 years. He likes the way it leaves his skin feeling clean and not at all oily.

avis.titre: I will never use anything else again.
avis.texte: I was using the charcoal face wash prior to using this one. I loved the charcoal but I always felt as there was a film of soap on my face like I didn't wash it off completely, when I did. I love how this face wash is clear and fragrance free, which is awesome if you have allergies and any heavy fragrance makes you stuffier. You don't need much, I use roughly a dime sized amount. Because of that, you get longer use out of the face wash. It doesn't dry skin out and makes it soft.

avis.titre: This is a staple for my husband
avis.texte: He uses it everyday. Keeps his skin clean and smooth. Gentle on his sensitive skin.
I use the product daily along with the exfoliating lotion, the maximum hydration serum and the maximum hydration moisturizer
Purchased this product for my husband. It is a noticeable difference between when he uses it & when he doesn't... his overall complexion is smoother & radiant. I highly recommend it.
My husband has never been particular about face wash, but he LOVES this! It deep cleans his face, without over drying or breaking him out! Highly recommend!

We got sample sizes of a few Clinique products a while back and my husband loved this so much he wanted a full size of it. He is 42 and recently realized he needs to take better care of his skin. He's happy with the way this makes his skin look and feel.

avis.titre: I have been buying this over and over again for my husband.
avis.texte: My husband has been using this for 3yeard I introduced him since I have been using clinic for over 6 years.

avis.titre: Amazing face wash very gentle to the skin.
avis.texte: Great product that does the job. I have sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate my skin and is very gentle. I use this face wash with the moisture surge hydrator and works wonders for my dry skin.

I use this face wash daily and it works great. I have seen good changes in my skin and shaving after use gives me a smooth clean face and neck. I like this product from Clinique a lot and everything else they offer.
My husband cant live without this facewash. He loves how gentle it is on his face (he hates my exfoliating washes). He says the $$ is worth it for the product he receives.
I used this to clear my face. It helps to remove the face oil. It makes my skin feel very clean.
I buy this for my husband all the time. He doesn't use anything else besides this..
I use the product daily before shaving, it cleans without drying my face.
I bought this for my 12-year-old son who has mild acne issues, but also has sensitive skin. We could see a difference overnight!
